papers.paperTitle: Physiology, Pharmacology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Regulations and General Knowledge

topics: Physiology: Whole human blood (I.P.), Composition and function of Blood elements, Coagulation of blood, Blood groups, Blood components, manufacturing and storage, Blood bank operation, requirement and standards
Pathophysiology: STD, AIDS, Hypersensitivity, Hepatitis and HBSAg

Pharmacology: Chemistry, SAR, Factors modifying drug action, and mechanism of drugs belonging to Coagulation and hematinics, Anti-hypertensives, CHF, Angina, arrhythmia, diuretics, CNS drugs, Chemotherapeutic agents, Anti-diabetics, contraceptives, endocrine and Hormones, uterine drugs, Respiratory drugs, GIT drugs, Autocoids, Immuno-stimulants and immuno-suppressants, Introduction to drug design and combinatorial chemistry

Toxicology: Classification of poison, chelating agents, heavy metal, insecticide poisoning, antidotes, Sign, symptoms and management of CNS drug poisons, Genotoxicity, carcinogenicity, teratogenicity, mutagenicity
Sterilization principles and procedures, Aseptic techniques, Disinfections, pyrogen and pyrogen testing
Assay of antibiotics and vitamins
Biochemical, serological, virological techniques
BoD, different media
Microbial drugs, drug resistance, microbial limit test, Pathogenic organism of common occurrence

units.unitTitle: Biochemistry and Chemistry of drugs / Pharmaceuticals
units.unitTitleMr: जैव रसायनशास्त्र आणि औषधांचे रसायनशास्त्र / फार्मास्युटिकल्स
topics: Biochemistry: Metabolism of carbohydrates, proteins and lipids, DNA, RNA, nucleic acid and components, Enzymes, Recombinant technology and its applications, Immunological products – vaccines, sera
Chemistry: Isomers, tautomers, fermentation, synthesis of antibiotics, diazo reaction, chemistry of steroids
Pre-formulation studies, Pharmaceuticals, Industrial Pharmacy, Cosmetic science
Principal and application of analysis using spectroscopy, chromatography, quality assurance and quality management system
Pharmacy Practice: Community pharmacy, hospital pharmacy and drug distribution

units.unitTitle: Regulations related to drugs and General knowledge related to Pharmaceuticals
units.unitTitleMr: औषधांशी संबंधित नियम आणि औषधांशी संबंधित सामान्य ज्ञान
topics: Drugs and cosmetic Act 1940 and rules 1945
Drugs and Magic Remedies and Objectionable Advertisement Act 1954 and Rules
Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act 1985
Drugs Price Control Order 2013 and NPPA
Poisons Act 1919 and Maharashtra poison rules 1970
The Pharmacy Act 1948
Intellectual property rights, Consumer protection Act, Right to information Act
National health programs, WHO-GMP certification, IPC and Adverse Drug Reactions
Questions to test how far candidates can think quickly and accurately

importantNotes: Wherever Acts/Rule/Regulations are mentioned in syllabus, latest amendments/versions to be considered.
